UNSURE_items: Is there a well-maintained Fastify RBAC plugin (e.g., fastify-acl, fastify-rbac)?
Best practice for JWT role claim format: string array vs comma-separated?
Should permissions be cached in Redis or per-request DB lookup?

risk_list: Permission check only on frontend — bypass risk
Role hierarchy (admin > manager > viewer) hardcoded → hard to extend
No row-level ownership check (user can edit others' data)
JWT not invalidated on role change
Missing audit log for permission changes
dependency_choice: Custom RBAC middleware (no heavy npm package needed for MVP)
Database: roles table + permissions table + user_roles junction
JWT claims carry role IDs for stateless checks
